notes.text: The upper central ink number is 15. A separate, lighter pencil number 31 appears at the lower left. Both are transcribed, without asserting that the pencil number belongs to the main writer. The counted 26 physical inscription baselines include the heading, both numbers, the annotation below I-hat in (38), the separate MD- insertion, the raised cancelled tuple, the lower replacement type clause, and the upper cancelled/lower inserted continuation rows of (39).

Section 5 concerns specialization of MD-graphs; the heading’s et générisation is cancelled. The page describes specialization using strata of the product compactification and records the data of a constituent graph indexed parenthetically by alpha. Isomorphisms are required to fix I(alpha)=Ihat_alpha. This is a reading summary only, not a mathematical verification.

The live phrase type numérique (g_alpha,Ihat_alpha) is kept exactly as written, although the neighbouring cancelled expression and NB use nu-hat. No substitution of a cardinality for the visibly hatted I has been made. The sigma/g labels in (39) remain explicitly undecided.
